description: Cases every implementation of nemar.sensor-layout.v1 reproduces. Each case gives positions (name, x, y, z in the frame coordinate_system names, or, for template positions that name a montage, in that montage's frame, RAS, with coordinate_system n/a; null is not finite) and either the expected layout (center and center_method in the ALS frame, theta_deg and radius per row, null for a row without a finite position) or the word it is refused with. The expected theta and radius are eegprep's convertlocs(..., 'cart2topo') of the positions minus the center, with -180 written 180. frames lists the BIDS coordinate systems of each orientation: an implementation gives frame_als's layout for every ALS name and frame_ras's for every RAS name. cart2topo gives centered ALS points and the theta and radius each converts to, with no fit (theta within tolerance.cart2topo_theta_deg degrees, with no wrapping, and radius within tolerance.radius). Tolerances for the cases: radius within tolerance.radius; theta through the planar point (cos(theta) * radius, sin(theta) * radius), within tolerance.planar of the expected one, because theta is undefined at the pole; the center within tolerance.center_relative_to_scale times the largest distance of a finite position from their centroid.

cases.name: biosemi_128_ras
cases.description: eegprep's biosemi-128 cap in millimeters, x right, y anterior, z superior (CapTrak, an RAS frame).

cases.name: standard_10_5_als
cases.description: eegprep's 10-5 template (339 positions, fiducials removed) in meters, x anterior, y left, z superior (EEGLAB, an ALS frame).

cases.name: hydrocel_32_off_center
cases.description: eegprep's HydroCel 32 cap in centimeters (CapTrak), translated by (3, -1.5, 2): the sphere fit recovers the center.

cases.name: frame_ras
cases.description: Twelve HydroCel positions in an RAS frame; every RAS name gives this layout.

cases.name: frame_als
cases.description: The same twelve positions rotated into ALS; every ALS name gives this layout.

cases.name: ring_coplanar
cases.description: Nine positions on one circle, unevenly spaced and tilted 25 degrees: coplanar, so the sphere fit is degenerate, but concyclic, so the center is the circle's (not their centroid), and every radius is 0.5.

cases.name: disk_flat
cases.description: Thirty-two positions scattered over a disk in the plane z = 0: coplanar and not on one circle, so refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: collinear_positions
cases.description: Five positions on one line: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: nearly_collinear
cases.description: Five positions on one line but for 2.2e-12 off it at the middle one: not exactly collinear, so the circle fit's matrix is singular rather than its cross product zero; refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: three_positions
cases.description: Three positions: too few to fit a sphere, so refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: coincident_positions
cases.description: Four positions at one point: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: missing_positions
cases.description: HydroCel 32 with row 5's y and all of row 20 not finite (written null): those rows get no layout and the fit uses the others.

cases.name: template_montage
cases.description: Template positions: HydroCel 32 in meters, RAS, as the montage GSN-HydroCel-32 of views/montages gives them, with the coordinate system n/a. A template role names its montage, and every montage is RAS, so the layout is not refused.

cases.name: template_with_a_frame
cases.description: Template positions from a montage that also name a coordinate system (CapTrak) other than n/a: the frame is ambiguous, so refused.
